dedupe_keys.name: offshore wind farm profitability and visual impact optimization inputs

description: Input data for optimization is the deposit linked to the Data in Brief offshore wind-farm profitability workbench. Its producer describes wind inputs, a turbine power curve, costs, algorithm settings, coastline, forbidden zones and observer information. The public file inventory confirms one workbook named Offshore_HR.xlsx. Mendeley Data supplies the workbook without charge under CC BY 4.0. The describing article concerns the joint treatment of project economics and visual impact, but the short repository metadata do not establish geographic coverage, wind-record dates or temporal resolution. This limitation must be resolved from the workbook documentation before using the case as a regional benchmark. A reviewer-assessed use is checking offshore wind-farm layout and investment scenarios in energy-system simulations. model-pypsa is a related planning tool, although its optimization formulation and this workbook’s fields were not matched. No numerical values or cost assumptions were downloaded or recalculated.
